episodes.title: Walkman
episodes.summary: "How are you going to fight tomorrow? It starts tomorrow." After losing the cassette, Ui-Gyeom meets Yoon-Ki and their normal life is shaken up.

episodes.title: Emergency Room
episodes.summary: "Fighting is a talent, after all." After a fight with Seung-joon, he encounters an unexpected accident.

episodes.title: Privilege
episodes.summary: "I don't want to give in, not to them..." The resolve to fight back. Despair, visions, and an unexpected hand lead him on.

episodes.title: Hero Mask
episodes.summary: "The problem is there are too many bad guys in the world." Anger with nowhere to go and shaky justice. Yun and Yi decide to "revolutionize.

episodes.title: High School Heroes
episodes.summary: "Us? We just decided to be High School Super Heroes!!" Masked Yi-gyeom and Yoon-gi, the High School Super Heroes begin to move.

episodes.title: Bad Guy
episodes.summary: "That's enough. We have to be different from them." High School Super Heroes in action. Choi Ki-soo appears in front of the outrageous Yi-gyeom and Yoon-ki who is trying to stop him.
